description: This file defines the French (Belgium) culture locale for the DateJS library, including date formats, day and month names, regex patterns for parsing dates, timezone information, and various date manipulation methods.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds of the date instance to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date instance's time to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the current date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if the current date equals another date.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds the specified milliseconds to the date.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components based on the configuration object.
